open_questions: data/systems/karachi-circular-railway.json currently has status 'planned' and notes 'Not operational as a mass-transit system'. Pakistan Railways' own train list contradicts that: four KCR services exist. Decide whether to change the system to a partially-operational shuttle plus a planned full loop.
Submitting the TrainTiming form (train + date) returned no timetable rows for any train tested, so no KCR stop list or times could be extracted from the official site.
The stopping pattern of KCR-1..KCR-4 (City Station - Orangi and Pipri - City) is only described in news reporting, never on pakrail.gov.pk. It needs an RTI request or a direct ask.

Pakistan Railways publishes no GTFS, no station list and no API. The RABTA e-ticketing SPA (https://www.pakrailways.gov.pk/train) calls an undocumented private backend at https://isapi.pakrailways.gov.pk/v1/ ; that was NOT queried and needs permission, like the Kentkart case.
